shortDescription: Russia and Ukraine exchanged another wave of overnight strikes as US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff were set to travel to Kyiv from Moscow after talks with President Vladimir Putin, according to Bloomberg.The trip follows their meeting with Putin in Moscow.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Russia, Ukraine Trade Strikes as Kushner, Witkoff Head to Kyiv
